bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money from the clean water fund for a southeast regional groundwater protection and soil health initiative.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SOUTHEAST REGIONAL GROUNDWATER PROTECTION AND SOIL HEALTH INITIATIVE. +]

[+(a) $....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the clean water fund to the Board of Water and Soil Resources for grants to soil and water conservation districts in the counties of Dodge, Fillmore, Freeborn, Goodhue, Houston, Mower, Olmsted, Rice, Steele, Wabasha, and Winona to reduce leaching of excess crop nutrients into groundwater, immobilize unused nitrogen from the rooting zone, and reduce erosion as part of a new southeast regional groundwater protection and soil health initiative. +]

[+(b) Notwithstanding any provision of Minnesota Statutes, section 103F.06, to the contrary, a soil and water conservation district that receives a grant under this section may use the grant to make subgrants for projects that conform to the requirements and limitations of the Olmsted County groundwater protection and soil health initiative, including a cover crop program, alternative crops program, and a haying, grazing, and pasture enhancement program. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money from the clean water fund for a southeast regional groundwater protection and soil health initiative.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SOUTHEAST REGIONAL GROUNDWATER PROTECTION AND SOIL HEALTH INITIATIVE.

(a) $....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the clean water fund to the Board of Water and Soil Resources for grants to soil and water conservation districts in the counties of Dodge, Fillmore, Freeborn, Goodhue, Houston, Mower, Olmsted, Rice, Steele, Wabasha, and Winona to reduce leaching of excess crop nutrients into groundwater, immobilize unused nitrogen from the rooting zone, and reduce erosion as part of a new southeast regional groundwater protection and soil health initiative.

(b) Notwithstanding any provision of Minnesota Statutes, section 103F.06, to the contrary, a soil and water conservation district that receives a grant under this section may use the grant to make subgrants for projects that conform to the requirements and limitations of the Olmsted County groundwater protection and soil health initiative, including a cover crop program, alternative crops program, and a haying, grazing, and pasture enhancement program.
additions: APPROPRIATION; SOUTHEAST REGIONAL GROUNDWATER PROTECTION AND SOIL HEALTH INITIATIVE.

(a) $....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the clean water fund to the Board of Water and Soil Resources for grants to soil and water conservation districts in the counties of Dodge, Fillmore, Freeborn, Goodhue, Houston, Mower, Olmsted, Rice, Steele, Wabasha, and Winona to reduce leaching of excess crop nutrients into groundwater, immobilize unused nitrogen from the rooting zone, and reduce erosion as part of a new southeast regional groundwater protection and soil health initiative.

(b) Notwithstanding any provision of Minnesota Statutes, section 103F.06, to the contrary, a soil and water conservation district that receives a grant under this section may use the grant to make subgrants for projects that conform to the requirements and limitations of the Olmsted County groundwater protection and soil health initiative, including a cover crop program, alternative crops program, and a haying, grazing, and pasture enhancement program.
